# One potential request Passage

Public inert fixture for LOS-150. The source contains no real account or service
credentials. Filters, conditions and ERB raise if invoked; observation must never
execute them. The disposable producer uses only an explicitly admitted in-memory
SQLite schema. It does not send a request, save a model, enqueue a job or mail.

`produce.rb` pins Rails **8.1.4 before loading any answers**, copies the explicit
source into a new caller-owned directory, creates capture A and a separate partial
generation, then advances CURRENT to source B. `consume.rb` runs in a fresh
Rails-free process against exact installed Core/Map gems, follows finite public
Reader pages and actual rendered Source hrefs. Never run either from a checkout
load path. Root owns their finite execution and retained package/native identities.

`answer_cards.json` is the handwritten answer key. The consumer checks each action
independently and requires distinct saved action/filter/model/template witnesses.
Index and helper-chain actions acquire no save contribution. The conditional action
retains unknown conditions. Show remains two explicit alternative syntax definitions.

All scripts and cards are **AUTHORED UNRUN** in the source-only implementation.
Pure mock checks are a separate tier and establish no framework/native/artifact
or served acceptance. `served_protocol.md` owns the later actual browser tasks.
